- **Calling out to my Australian pharma network - we're hiring... For the last several years, I've led every BD conversation at Swipe Health and Rumi. Until now, that was the right call - there have been products to figure out, markets to learn, a vision to anchor. But we've reached the point where me doing the BD is the ceiling, not the strength. To this, we're hiring our first BD specialist who'll work alongside me to drive the next phase of growth across both companies. For me, that's a big moment (my 7yo would call it "dinosauric"). Where Swipe Health and Rumi sit today: Swipe Health : scientific exchange campaigns delivered across 40+ countries, with millions of engagements Rumi : hundreds of advisory boards and stakeholder activities run online to date, with some exciting announcements in store We're looking for someone with strong pharma understanding and the commercial instincts to build trusted relationships - pharma (commercial or medical), agency, or pharma tech / SaaS backgrounds all welcome. This is a "roll-up-your-sleeves" role. You'll be running at it from day one with outreach, pitches, follow-ups, deals... at pace. The difference is you won't be running at it from a standing start. You'd come in backed by real brand credibility, existing customer relationships across the Australian pharma industry, and direct founder support - your job is to take all of that and turn it into the next phase of growth across both businesses. Sydney based. Real upside for the right hire. I'm putting this out to my Australian network in particular - if this sounds like you, or someone who springs to mind, I'd love a DM or an introduction. (Job link in comments.) ...more**

- **CX-first engagement in pharma… Everyone is striving for it, but has anyone truly cracked it... at scale? Will AI finally be the enabler? Or, will outdated SOPs, fragile change management, “glocal” complexity, and siloed thinking continue to stall the few initiatives that actually show promise? These are exactly the questions we’ve been debating as we gear up for the NEXT Medical Festival in Brussels next week and our session: "Medical Affairs 3.0: CX-First Engagement Powered by Digital, Tech & AI" This won’t be another panel about shiny tools or AI hype. It'll be a practical, honest conversation about what actually needs to change inside organisations if CX-first engagement is to become a reality in 2026. Why this session is worth the ticket price alone: We’re bringing together four perspectives that rarely sit in the same room - but need to be aligned for CX to work: Michelle Bridenbaker – Medical Affairs Yazan Iwidat – Commercial Mara van Dorst – Digital & Technology Sam Rolfe ☁️ – AI & HCP Engagement ( Exeevo ) If you’re grappling with questions like: - Why pilots succeed but scaling fails - Why technology doesn’t translate into adoption - How to move from fragmented engagement to real CX …this session is for you.
